newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Carrier buys 26 pct of Tadiran Electric.
newsitem.headline: Carrier buys 26 pct of Tadiran Electric.

text.p: Carrier Corp, a subsidiary of United Technologies, has closed a deal to purchase 26 percent of Tadiran Electrical Appliances from Tadiran Ltd, Israel's Tadiran Ltd said on Thursday.
Tadiran said the U.S. company paid $17.5 million for the holding, which followed an earlier purchase of three percent of Tadiran Electric's shares in an off-the-market deal.

For the 26 percent stake, Carrier paid a premium of roughly $5.8 million on Tadiran Electric's market valuation. Based on the company's Wednesday closing price on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, the stake is worth approximately $11.7 million.
Tadiran said Carrier had an option to purchase a controlling 51 percent of Tadiran Electric in three to six years time. Tadiran maintains a 60 percent stake in Tadiran Electric after the sale.
Tadiran Electric and Carrier, which both manufacture air conditioners, also signed an agreement on joint management and future strategic cooperation.
The Carrier sale is in line with Tadiran's efforts to find multinational strategic partners for its operating units.
